(2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a clinical laser procedure where a medical handpiece emits rhythmic red flashes against a patient's facial skin. The lighting shifts to focus on the high-intensity laser light, highlighting the precision of the dermatological treatment being performed on the patient's cheek area. (3) The doctor returns to the screen, using expressive hand gestures to emphasize the prevalence of oily skin types among the population. It highlights that thick, greasy creams can clog pores and cause acne after a laser treatment, suggesting that water-based essences containing PGA and EGF are more effective for repair.
